limitations: Observed appearance IDs are not verified official themes.
Crop-dependent changes do not prove inaccurate corners; manual annotations also have limited precision.
Co-occurring marks/moire/styles do not establish causation. No isolated blur/glare experiment.
Detection failure has no automatic square predictions; null is not zero errors.

previousExperimentsNotRepeated.scope: Historical v1 geometry; preserve rejected conclusions, do not substitute for current v2 metrics.
previousExperimentsNotRepeated.decision: Keep digital conservative and photo-v1. Reject all three resampling variants and photo robustness v2: baseline-correct boards are lost. Obtain targeted style examples before further training.
